name: Necrotic Ooze — gains activated abilities of creature cards in all graveyards
notes: Memory: project_necrotic_ooze_graveyard_abilities_2026-04-15. Ooze has the activated abilities of every creature card in every graveyard (including the opponent's), but not of non-creature cards. Elves (p1 graveyard) and Birds (p2 graveyard) are creature cards; Sol Ring is an artifact so its ability must not be gained.

$includes: {T}: Add one mana of any color.
